method: Read-only source/contracts/existing evidence review. No UI, Agent, parser, Worker, tests or original database was run/read. Native pixels were observed only by root.

reportedNative.sequence: window-boundaries.docx: paragraph inner part2/2 and table rows21–21/columns13–13; confirm whole table opinion; collapse; click same file link to reopen. Opinion retained, paragraph/table returned to first window.
reportedNative.evidence: Root team message; native receipt not yet supplied to this reviewer.

findings.cause: Paragraph inner part and table row/column use local zero-initialized state; no reading-position callbacks. active=false removes the document subtree, so same-version hide/show resets them.
findings.scope: Existing document reading ref stores story and top-level20-block segment only. Nested cell BlockSequence also has no saved position callback.

findings.cause: Each file-link selection increments selection; ArtifactPane assigns the request and keys OpenedFileView by selection. New OpenedFileView creates a fresh reading ref, even for same task/path.
findings.scope: Same-link reopen differs from merely opening the retained content pane. It can discard outer reading refs for other formats too; no separate native observation of those formats is claimed.

contractAssessment.plan: plans/agent-access.md:P20 requires retaining reading position; observed scope is incomplete, not grounds to lower it.
contractAssessment.historicalBoundary: reading-position/implementation.json explicitly records story/top-level20-block support and excludes paragraph inner-part/table-detail position. Existing native file-refresh receipt covers21–40 outer paragraph groups, not long paragraph inner parts or table subwindows.
contractAssessment.classification: Unfinished reading-position coverage revealed by native journey. No evidence this new DOCX feedback change regressed previously verified inner-position behavior. Saved opinion/version retention is separate and was reported intact.

minimalDesign.step: Retain transient reading carrier through a same-task/path reselection
minimalDesign.detail: Lift/pass a small reading ref above the selection-key remount (or equivalent explicit state transfer). Keep fresh file verification and old source retirement. Only apply after actual root/resolved identity matches; never preserve readiness, capture owner or feedback selection by merely reusing a React key.

minimalDesign.step: Record inner viewport coordinates separately from feedback
minimalDesign.detail: Add a bounded in-memory document viewport map keyed by actual part+elementPath+kind (and appropriate verified document/version identity), holding paragraph part/table row+column and required nested viewport path. No text, bitmap, content ledger or automatically confirmed target.

Same verified version can restore exact valid coordinates. New/shortened/restructured documents must clamp against actual current block bounds or reset when correspondence is unavailable; an old structural path alone does not prove unchanged semantic content. Changing story/window still retires candidates.

requiredCounterexamples: Exact native fullApp sequence with long paragraph2/2 and table21/13 restores both after collapse and same-link reopen while opinion bytes remain unchanged.
Control: reopen through retained pane rather than new link; distinguish parent-ref loss from inner-state loss.
Nonzero outer story/segment plus inner part/table window restore without revived old confirmation source.
Same-version new prepared object and hide during read; no duplicated OS read or stale status adoption.
Shortened paragraph/table clamps to valid bounds; changed story/block kind/removed path does not borrow another block's position.
Different file/task/root/resolved identity and repeated text/IDs do not share viewport state.
Nested table/cell sequence if included by implementation: distinct block paths and bounded state, no unbounded map growth.
currentAction: No source modified. Recommend a separate scoped repair preserving existing ownership gates; root decides timing alongside current XLSX-range development.
